metadata.title: Supplementary Information (SI): California & North San Joaquin Valley Agricultural Biomass Residue Factors and Volume Estimation Reference Table
metadata.key_policy: All programmatic joins and lookups match on immutable lowercase canonical names (resource_name, primary_ag_product_name, unit_name, parameter_name). Volatile integer primary key IDs are never hardcoded.
metadata.single_year_reporting_rule: Never sum multi-year panels (e.g., 2017+2022 USDA Census or 2023+2024 County Ag Reports) without filtering on a single dataset_year.

records.verified_wet_factor_range: 1.15 - 1.60 wet hull t / t dry in-shell pistachios

records.verified_wet_factor_range: 0.108 - 0.161 air-dry shell t / t harvested in-shell (at 25% cracking share); 0.49 anatomical

records.reference_cultivar_region: Kerman, Golden Hills; SJV (Closed-boundary NSJV crop vs. Open-boundary South SJV central processing plants)
records.audit_status: Current 0.15 approximates commercial cracking share (~25-30% of 0.49 anatomical shell); document closed vs. open boundary caveat (#509)
records.citations: Administrative Committee for Pistachios (ACP 2024) Statistical Report; Ferguson & Haviland (2016) UC ANR Pub 3545; Williams et al. (2015)
